entities.name: Stormwreck Sea
entities.description: Vast ocean region of Ixalan between the Sun Empire and Torrezon, domain of the Brazen Coalition pirates.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirate society that rejects land-bound nations and became a legitimate nation after the invasion.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: The Coalition's floating city of lashed-together wrecks, a neutral meeting ground.

entities.name: Spitfire Bastion
entities.description: Island fortress once held by Captain Ripley Vance.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: Pirate captain who held the Spitfire Bastion.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: Spit of land where Jace Beleren was stranded, now home to Azor.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker stranded on Useless Island after losing to Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Sphinx now living on Useless Island.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampires who conquered Torrezon and later recognized the Coalition.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire that refused refugees safe harbor and later recognized the Coalition.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Continent conquered by the Legion of Dusk around 98 BD.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Pirate captain and admiral who founded High and Dry, retook it from invasion, and became the Coalition's first Governor.

entities.name: Jareth Wake
entities.description: Captain who founded High and Dry with Beckett Brass.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that shattered the Coalition's old order.

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk conquers Torrezon; refugees refused harbor by the Sun Empire turn to raiding at sea.
events.quote: The Stormwreck Sea became a haven for outcasts when the Legion of Dusk conquered Torrezon around 98 BD .

events.summary: The ships Scourge and Squid Eyes collide and tangle; Beckett Brass and Jareth Wake found High and Dry on the wreckage.
events.quote: Their captains — Beckett Brass and Jareth Wake — founded High and Dry on the wreckage

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion refugees crowd High and Dry; Brass and her fleet retake the city and she becomes de facto leader.
events.quote: Brass emerged as the de facto leader of the battered survivors.

events.summary: Beckett Brass declares the age of piracy over, makes the Coalition a legitimate nation and becomes its first Governor.
events.quote: Beckett Brass declared the age of piracy over

relations.quote: became the first Governor of the Coalition's new island and coastal holdings
